{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter for completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the revenue column for non-numeric values
non_numeric_revenue = df_completed[~df_completed['revenue'].astype(str).str.replace('.', '').str.isdigit()]

# Display any non-numeric entries
print(non_numeric_revenue[['order_id', 'revenue']].to_string(index=False))"}
